candidates.title: Prism Relay
candidates.goal: Rotate prisms to connect and charge three receivers in 45 seconds
candidates.shorts_moment: A broken beam clicks into a continuous glowing circuit and charges the receiver
candidates.reason: Clear objective, stationary mobile board, visible cause/effect, bounded deterministic puzzles, strongly distinct from all eight public mechanics.

candidates.title: Balance Bloom
candidates.goal: Place weighted seeds to keep a platform balanced while growing a flower
candidates.shorts_moment: An asymmetric stack stabilizes then blooms
candidates.reason: Distinct mechanic, but readable mass/torque feedback and touch placement tuning add physics risk for the first commissioning.

candidates.title: Fold Harbor
candidates.goal: Slide two translucent shape layers to reveal a docking silhouette
candidates.shorts_moment: Two fragments align into one luminous emblem
candidates.reason: Distinct from the catalog, but explaining two-layer selection in five seconds is less reliable than directly tapping a visible prism.

selection_basis: Qualitative commissioning criteria, no numeric fun score. Three ideas, one actual candidate; no second generation on rejection.
